Return IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against the target with chembl_id CHEMBL2039 (human amine oxidase [flavin-containing] B). Use the strict provenance join path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Filter activities where standard_type = 'IC50' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2039'. Join compound_structures via INNER JOIN on molregno for canonical_smiles. Output columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles, compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fall back to docs.doi), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by all output columns in the listed order.
